theme: An open day, Croatia four days out.
greeting: Clear calendar today, Dan, and the girls are with you in St. Pete — a good day to lock the last Croatia bookings before Tuesday's flight.

needsAttention.title: Confirm checked bags are on the Croatia ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags, Basic Economy on Eurowings Discover. Two 55L duffels won't pass as carry-on — verify baggage on the operating carrier's site and buy it online before counter rates hit.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 19 Cavtat night and transfer
needsAttention.detail: The charter ends noon Sept 19 at ACI Komolac; you need one refundable night in Cavtat plus a pre-booked marina transfer before the 7:30 AM Sunday flight. Connectivity aboard is poor, so this has to be booked from dry land before Tuesday.

needsAttention.title: Book the St. Pete landing-gap nights, Sept 20-22
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sunday Sept 20 from Croatia, but the girls aren't picked up until Tuesday the 22nd — two St. Pete nights are still open before the Orlando villa starts.

needsAttention.title: Send your bio to Ellen and Deb
needsAttention.detail: Your Sept 1 note to self: send your bio and email to Ellen Richstone and Deb Rosenthal at NACD New England. They're organizing the Oct 28 event you're part of, with the prep call set for Oct 8.

flagged.title: VP, State Government Affairs role posted
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn alert flagged a remote VP of State Government Affairs opening in Maryland — worth a look for the search.

flagged.title: NACD New England prep session
flagged.detail: Larissa Ravetto scheduled the prep Zoom for the Oct 28 event on Thursday Oct 8, 1 PM ET.

flagged.title: C&C Sprayfoam estimate, $12,450
flagged.detail: A QuickBooks estimate arrived via Intuit, marked due Dec 31 — review when you have a moment.

flagged.title: ICGN Autumn Conference, Toronto
flagged.detail: Bookings are open for the November ICGN governance conference.

inbox.noise: The rest is retail and newsletter promos — Slightly Foxed, Sailing Virgins, MOO, OXO, The Key.
inbox.clear: The sailing-course intros and the St. Pete Airbnb are settled — nothing owed there.

resolved.title: Croatia course intros wrapped up
resolved.detail: You sent your intro Aug 31; instructor Paul and the crew all replied — the thread's complete.

recipe.title: Roasted kabocha squash
recipe.why: Early autumn brings the first hard squashes to market — roasting concentrates their sweetness.

tasks.title: Buy EU plug adapters + US power strip before Sept 8

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar to answer to this morning.
A wide, unscheduled middle — the kind of open block that's been rare lately.
Girls with you in St. Pete, and four days until the flight; an easy home night.
